# A provider in a component's body around its slot, whose value reads the
# component's own state, gives the slot's content that value -- and a test's
# read of a node in the content reads it too.
#
# The content is the caller's, and the context lowering hands it the
# provider's value as the callee wrote it (collectSlotEnv): `picked`, the
# callee's var. The inliner renamed that var `picked__inst0` in the body it
# spliced and not in the content it put in the slot, so bubbletea, fyne and
# gtk4 did not build ("undefined: picked") and html read nothing. A test's
# read of `c.said.value` now stands under the provider around the slot as
# well as those around the node (design/testing.md).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

context #tone("plain")

func shout(s string) => tone == "loud" ? "{s}!" : s

// A choice of tone, which the content it wraps reads.
component chooser(content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    var picked = "plain"

    ui.select #pick(:value=picked) {
        ui.choice(label="plain")
        ui.choice(label="loud")
    }
    tone(picked) {
        content
    }
}

// The same, the tone a prop.
component wrap(level string, content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    tone(level) {
        content
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var mood = "loud"

    chooser #choice {
        ui.text #said(value=shout("hi"))
    }
    wrap #w(level=mood) {
        ui.text #told(value=shout("yo"))
    }
    ui.button #calm(text="calm", @click { mood = "plain" })
}

func testTheChoiceIsTheTone(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.said.value == "hi")
    c.choice.pick.change("loud")
    t.assert(c.choice.picked == "loud")
    t.assert(c.said.value == "hi!")
}

func testTheWrapsPropIsTheTone(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.told.value == "yo!")
    c.calm.click()
    t.assert(c.told.value == "yo")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
